passages.text:
Asks for Meta from USAID/Guate/DGO & MO
Addressing Disinformation
• Please keep focused on controlling disinformation, particularly as it regards efforts to undermining democracy.
• This includes making the needed investments in personnel and language translation/algorithms in countries with
weaker institutions, where social media is used to harass or persecute people unfairly.
• Political stability, democratic governance, and accurate information not only benefit these countries and the U.S.
generally, but creates greater certainty for their (FB's) own investments and longer-term viability.
Identifying and removing Coyote and other Scam Accounts
• Can a process be defined which could streamline the process for canceling facebook pages used to promote coyote
services or fake work visas? Anything that makes it harder for coyote type scammers would be helpful.
Prevention and Response to Fraud, Trafficking in Persons (TIP), Human Smuggling/Irregular Migration
1. Engagement around preventing, mitigating, and responding to migrant smuggling (coyotes) and human trafficking
experienced by Guatemalans on Meta's and other widely-used platforms as a means for recruitment and
communication.
2. Engagement around preventing, mitigating, and responding to fraud and misinformation campaigns regarding
temporary work visa programs.
3. Engagement around mitigating the use of Meta products in the formation of mass migrant movements (Caravans)
and cross-national migrant movements.
Improve coordination and activism related to extortion, child pornography, online harassment
Given the increase in extortions, child pornography, and online harassment, Meta should work to help prevent/combat
these issues on their platforms. Recommend Meta explores coordination on:
• Better tools for detecting and reporting these crimes on Meta's platforms.
• More detailed training for local authorities on spotting and preventing these issues.
• A partnership between to train the police and Meta to address digital threats more effectively.
